title: SENSEI: SENSITIVE SET INVARIANCE FOR ENFORCING INDIVIDUAL FAIRNESS

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of gendered pronouns and names in textual biographies, and altering gender features in tabular census data to measure prediction consistency and gaps in true positive rates.

Computing accuracy parity across racial identity context labels in toxic comment classification, and altering race features in tabular census data to measure individual prediction consistency and group true positive rate gaps.

Counterfactual token substitution (e.g., interchanging words like 'gay' and 'straight') in online comments to evaluate prediction consistency and counterfactual token fairness, alongside accuracy parity across identity groups.
Measuring accuracy parity across subsets of data labeled with religious identity contexts (e.g., 'muslim') in a toxic comment detection task.
Altering marital status features in tabular census data to measure prediction consistency (referred to as spouse consistency).
